hints.title: Digit Frequency Count
hints.text: Count the frequency of each digit '0', '1', ..., 'n-1' appearing in string num.

hints.title: Indexed Value Verification
hints.text: For each index i from 0 to n - 1, compare the actual count of digit str(i) with the required value int(num[i]).

hints.title: All Conditions Must Hold
hints.text: Return true if every index satisfies the condition, and false immediately upon any mismatch.

hints.title: Digit Frequency Validation Implementation

variables: n: length of string num (up to 10)
complexity.notes: Single pass frequency count with at most 10 digits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex failure mode; straight tallying is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency table stores up to 10 digit counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks digit counts up to length n without off-by-one errors.
